cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need space for smaller ambitions; I'll manage our withdrawal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, withdrawing my strongest work gives them room to recover. Collect whenever suits you; I'll wrap everything your way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm conceding the pavement too. Park wherever is easiest and tell me which end to lift. We'll clear their entrance completely; they can discover how empty it looks without us.
